# UserPassword

`c.UserPassword` calls the API's UserPassword group. The password of a user.

## Methods

| Method                                    | Returns                                     | Permission   | Description                 |

| [`Update(ctx, hostname, input)`](#update) | `*Response[Collection[UserPasswordResult]]` | `user:write` | Set the password of a user. |

### Update

```go
func (s *UserPasswordService) Update(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
	input UserPasswordUpdateInput,
) (*Response[Collection[UserPasswordResult]], error)
```

Set the password of a user.

Sets the password with chpasswd -e, from its hash on standard input. The
controller hashes the password, so the job and NATS have only the hash. Each
call makes a new hash, so it always reports changed: true. A user that the host
does not have is not found. It runs on the Debian family only, and elsewhere
reports skipped.

It sends `PUT /api/node/{hostname}/user/{name}/password`, and needs the
permission `user:write`.

The examples of the method's definition:

Set a password, `go run user_password.go update`:

```go
resp, err := c.UserPassword.Update(ctx, target, client.UserPasswordUpdateInput{
	Name:     "osapitest",
	Password: "-",
})
```
